locations.title: Intercom
locations.description:
Speak with Radio Specialist Alan Leiter through the intercom.  He will send soldiers to attack unless you pass a skill check:
- Speech 13 -OR- Hack 13

If skill check is passed, tell the Specialist that Scientist Winifred Woo is needed in the Sickbay, after previously [obtaining the necessary info](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/reconstituted-horizon-point?locationIds=504231) from ["Doctor" Rust](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/reconstituted-horizon-point?locationIds=504218)

locations.title: Zyranium Tank
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the maintenance shaft accessed via the [Locked Hatch](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/reconstituted-horizon-point?locationIds=504308)

**Options:**
- [1] Repair the leak
  - Engineering 20
    - OR
  - Trait: Innovative

Jump to the platform above the tank to avoid the [Zyranium Spill](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/reconstituted-horizon-point?locationIds=504317) and access the [Turret Power Panel](https://mapgenie.io/the-outer-worlds-2/maps/reconstituted-horizon-point?locationIds=504321)
